newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Armed men kill Belgian nun, children in Rwanda.
newsitem.headline: Armed men kill Belgian nun, children in Rwanda.

text.p: A Belgian nun and a number of children were killed when armed men attacked a school in northwestern Rwanda early on Monday,The Belgian Foreign Ministry said.
A spokesman confirmed a report that said the incident took place in an unstable area where similar acts of aggression had been committed in the past.

He said the nun, who was head mistress of the school in the town of Murumba, originally came from the Belgian town of Leuven, east of Brussels. Indications were that she had not been killed because she was white, but because she was a member of the school's staff.
Belgium's ambassador in the capital of Kigali was travelling to the area, the spokesman said, adding the woman's family had been informed. He gave no further details.
